source: Bhrigu Bindu = midpoint of Moon and Rahu, arc taken from Rahu to Moon in zodiacal order: (Moon + Rahu)/2 with Moon taken as Moon + 360 when Moon < Rahu; as popularised in The Astrological Magazine and implemented in Jagannatha Hora (P.V.R. Narasimha Rao)
conventionNotes: Arc from Rahu to Moon (zodiacal) is used. Alternative: midpoint of the shorter arc between Moon and Rahu; it differs by exactly 180 degrees whenever the Rahu-to-Moon arc exceeds 180 degrees (shorterArcLongitude is given for reference).
Rahu longitude follows the configured node method (mean/true).
